title: ArtifactDeliveredData
description: data of artifact.delivered (PRD 9.5): a deliverable reached the Delivery Dock. This event is the notice, not the side effect, so it carries no authz. A format that leaves Tilo (email, or google_docs, google_sheets or google_slides through the Drive connector, PRD 12.4) went through the outbox: outbox_id names the entry that sent it, and the event's cause is that entry's data.transfer out, which carries the authorisation (EV-14, HR-7). A format kept in Tilo (a file to download, or in_app) has outbox_id null. 1.1.0 (ADR-0050): make_with says where the deliverable was made, and a website always carries it. A deliverable a partner made (make_with not native: a Lovable build link, a Canva export) left Tilo through that partner's T3 outbox entry, so outbox_id names it and the cause is its data.transfer out (EV-14); a native one kept in Tilo has outbox_id null.

format.description: A website always says where it was made (ADR-0050). Keyed by a required field, so it always applies; the root keeps one if/then/else.
